## load data
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

facility_level <- read_csv("clean_data/facility_level.csv")
sport_level <- read_csv("clean_data/sport_level.csv")

park_accessibility_lga <-
  read_csv("clean_data/park_accessibility_lga.csv")
```



```{r}
facility_accessibility_lga <- facility_level |>
  group_by(LGA_CODE, LGA_NAME) |>
  summarise(
    facility_count = n_distinct(facility_id),
    total_fields_courts = sum(n_fields_courts, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_sports_per_facility = mean(n_sports, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

sport_accessibility_lga <- sport_level |>
  filter(!is.na(sports_played)) |>
  group_by(LGA_CODE, LGA_NAME) |>
  summarise(
    sport_opportunity_count =
      n_distinct(facilty_sport_played_id),

    sport_type_count =
      n_distinct(sports_played),

    facilities_with_sport_data =
      n_distinct(facility_id),

    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}

accessibility_raw_lga <- park_accessibility_lga |>
  full_join(
    facility_accessibility_lga,
    by = c("LGA_CODE", "LGA_NAME")
  ) |>
  full_join(
    sport_accessibility_lga,
    by = c("LGA_CODE", "LGA_NAME")
  )
```
